result.title: Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams
result.summary: Temporal point processes are used both to measure market mechanisms, for example how fast prices absorb news and how much of the reaction is the market responding to itself, and to predict the next event. We show that one algebraic object, the phase-type (Erlang-chain) state space, serves both purposes with exact likelihoods. For measurement, we build a multiscale phase-type Hawkes process whose parameters all enter linearly. Its log-likelihood is concave, and we compute the global maximum together with a Fenchel duality-gap certificate. A Markov embedding gives the response to an exogenous shock, echoes included, in closed form, and this response is stable if and only if the spectral radius of the branching matrix is below one. Applied to six markets around 670 scheduled macroeconomic releases (2022-2026) with a built-in placebo test, the model shows that the direct reaction to CPI, payrolls, PPI and the FOMC statement is absorbed in about a second, while the market's own echoes stretch half of the response to 16-137 s. For prediction, we introduce EPT-X, a neural point process that adds a history-dependent mixture-of-Erlang renewal channel to a linear Hawkes backbone. Its intensity and compensator remain in closed form, its states follow an affine recursion that trains with a parallel scan, and it can start from the certified fit of the measurement model. EPT-X has the best test likelihood on all five LOBSTER order-book streams and on Retweet and Taobao, and is level with the best published model on StackOverflow. We also find that the EasyTPP implementation of IntensityFree clamps short inter-event times before scoring, and that the gaps of the EasyTPP Amazon data are uniform on two fixed intervals.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 phase-type（Erlang 链）状态空间统一事件流的测量与预测：构造参数线性、对数似然凹且带 Fenchel 对偶间隙证书的多尺度 Hawkes 过程，并提出神经点过程 EPT-X，在线性 Hawkes 主干上加入历史相关的 Erlang 更新混合通道，状态满足仿射递推、可用并行扫描训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其显式 phase-type 隐状态、mixture-of-Erlang 通道的仿射递推与并行扫描，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的并行更新与多 latent 假设混合提供方法线索，其对偶间隙证书也可供核查「latent 内容是否真被使用」的验证思路。
